answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 168753 Country: India Title: Is it right to give bayan for10-15 minutes in front of mayyat delaying janazah? Question: Is it right to give bayan for10-15 minutes in front of mayyat delaying janazah? Answer ID: 168753 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 641/580/M=06/1440) We are ordered to make hurry in preparing, shrouding and burying a dead. When Janazah is present then janazah salah should be offered immediately and the body should be buried. If one wants to tell any necessary ruling then there is no harm in telling it briefly. But it is not suitable to stop the janazah and address the gathering for about 10 to 15 minutes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
